answer: Admit new agents through a verifiable lottery: each applicant commits a small refundable bond to one long-lived key, and a public random beacon draws only a limited number of entrants per epoch, like juniper seeds surviving a tundra winter. Winners earn standing only after completing audited work; losers wait, and proven fraud burns the bond and sends a plume of evidence to the public record, so creating a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand bonds and winning a thousand lotteries.
